operations.description: Read the connection's own key record: its label, limits, usage and whether it is a management key
List the account's workspaces, one page per call, paged by offset and limit
List the account's API keys by hash, label, limits and usage, one page per call, filtered by workspace_id and paged by offset; never their secrets

Create one API key from body; OpenRouter requires body.name. The new key, shown once, is held in custody as a new connection of the configured target alias and never returned: the result is that connection and the key's hash. Unguarded: nothing exists to compare before a create, so the same input approved and sent again creates a second key. body.limit sets its spending limit in USD, body.limit_reset its reset period, body.expires_at its expiry and body.workspace_id its workspace
